method: Read-only production catalog and public finance aggregate SQL
query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'summary_columns', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',column_name,'type',data_type) ORDER BY ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='v_finance_summary'),
  'registry', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'districts',count(DISTINCT district_number),'first_year',min(year),'last_year',max(year),'invalid_district_ids',count(*) FILTER (WHERE district_number !~ '^[0-9]{6}$'),'nonpositive_or_missing_enrollment',count(*) FILTER (WHERE fall_survey_enrollment IS NULL OR fall_survey_enrollment <=0)) FROM public.texas_school_finance),
  'duplicate_district_year_keys', (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT district_number,year FROM public.texas_school_finance GROUP BY district_number,year HAVING count(*)>1) duplicates),
  'latest_finance', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('year',2025,'rows',count(*),'total_spend',sum(total_spend),'enrollment',sum(enrollment),'spend_per_student_mismatches',count(*) FILTER (WHERE spend_per_student IS DISTINCT FROM round(total_spend::numeric/NULLIF(enrollment,0),2))) FROM public.v_finance_summary WHERE year=2025),
  'dallas_2025', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('district_number',district_number,'year',year,'total_spend',total_spend,'enrollment',enrollment,'stored_spend_per_student',spend_per_student,'correct_spend_per_student',round(total_spend::numeric/NULLIF(enrollment,0),2),'stored_revenue_per_student',revenue_per_student,'correct_revenue_per_student',round(total_revenue::numeric/NULLIF(enrollment,0),2)) FROM public.v_finance_summary WHERE district_number='057905' AND year=2025)
) AS audit;
